"Double The Money" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Every line of Double The Money's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2415.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

2416.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "Loaded with $2,000s" have been sold. The game is well into its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "Loaded with $2,000s" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2416.headline: Tickets sold so far

2419.body:
One of Bronze 7s's top prizes was claimed last week. A player in Virginia won $2,777. The game started with four top prizes and now has one top prize. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

The numbers for "Bronze 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2419.headline: Fewer $2,777 prizes left

2420.body:
One of Silver 7s's top prizes was claimed two weeks ago. A player in Virginia won $177,777. The game started with three top prizes and now has two top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

Every line of Silver 7s's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2420.headline: Top prize count went down

2421.body:
A $577,777 top prize on "Gold 7s" was claimed four days ago. The game started with three top prizes and has one top prize left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Tomorrow's count on "Gold 7s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2421.headline: The top prize list got shorter

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" has had no $2 million top prize claimed for close to two months. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything here about "Platinum 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 1.
2422.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

2426.body:
"HAUNTED HUNDREDS" has 91,013 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50 prize, with 702 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Every line of HAUNTED HUNDREDS's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2426.headline: A close look at the prizes

2427.body:
"HOLIDAY TRIPLER" has joined the Virginia lineup at $1 with 602 top prizes of $300. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

The numbers for "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2427.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $2 game with five top prizes of $25,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything here about "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 1.
2428.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" just went on sale in Virginia. The game has eleven full prize levels with four top prizes of $125,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Everything above about "MERRY MONEY TREE" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2429.headline: A new game is here

2430.body:
"WRAPPED IN RICHES" just reached Virginia stores with three top prizes of $500,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Tomorrow's count on "WRAPPED IN RICHES" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2430.headline: New game, all prizes left
